sections.Profile:
The "Striker" pinball machine by Gottlieb, released in November 1982, features a unique layout with six flippers and a wide-body cabinet design. It includes 14 drop targets, four slingshots, and two spinners, offering a dynamic gameplay experience. Despite being released during a challenging time for pinball manufacturers, 910 units were produced. The game is known for its creative design and distinctive sound effects, including speech and cheering crowds.
